snippet.title: Where It Happened - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Developed by Waycore Studio, a small team of two, Where It Happened is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore the house by following clues to solve puzzles, experience supernatural events and uncover the horrifying truth in the end.

Check out Where It Happened on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4631470/Where_It_Happened/
